name: hn-digest
description: Fetches the Hacker News front page and writes a compact digest.
instructions: When the user (or a scheduled job) asks for a Hacker News digest: call hn_top to fetch the current front page (default 10 stories). Then write a digest: one line per story — `N. title (points ▲) — url` — followed by a 2–3 sentence read on themes worth noticing. Keep the whole digest under 3500 characters so it fits a Telegram message. Do not editorialize beyond the closing read; never invent stories.
